DECPI.alias: shared ChargePoint/KLING-associated prefix with multiple physical operators
DECPI.canonicalEvidence: The certified Germany coverage audit shows DECPI across 97 sites with multiple physical operators; top operators include KLING Charging Solutions GmbH, Stadtwerke Gütersloh GmbH and GEW Wilhelmshaven GmbH.

evidence.finding: DE*CPI EVSEs at a KLING Charging Solutions site, confirming the prefix is used in public infrastructure.
DE*CPI EVSEs also occur at an Autohaus Ebersberg-operated site, confirming the prefix is not one homogeneous physical CPO.

DECPI.decision: No DECPI-wide tariff. Resolve physical operator and exact direct tariff per EVSE/site.
DECPI.unblockForComplete: Map all DECPI EVSEs to physical tariff authority and authoritative station-level direct-payment contract.

evidence.finding: Munich Airport publishes current campus charging tariffs: AC 0.49 EUR/kWh and DC 0.69 EUR/kWh.
Airport-operated fast chargers: ad-hoc 0.69 EUR/kWh plus 0.20 EUR/min after 90 minutes; partner Audi/ENI stations explicitly excluded from airport tariff authority.
P44/P51 self-service AC charging is 0.49 EUR/kWh with QR/smartphone direct payment; parking remains separate where applicable.

DEFMG.decision: Official tariff rules are exact, but keep partial until the 285 canonical DEFMG EVSEs are deterministically mapped to the applicable AC versus airport-operated DC rule and any non-FMG partner chargers are excluded by EVSE identity.
DEFMG.unblockForComplete: Attach each canonical DEFMG EVSE to AC 0.49 rule or airport-operated DC 0.69 + post-90min 0.20/min rule; prove no partner-operated EVSE is incorrectly included.

evidence.finding: CITYWATT publicly described ad-hoc charging at 0.65 EUR/kWh, but the page is older and cannot prove a 2026 network-wide current tariff.
Current station-level data via Mobilithek discovery shows DE*CIW AC EVSEs at 0.44 EUR/kWh.
Current station-level DE*CIW HPC EVSEs at Thiersheim show 0.70 EUR/kWh.

DECIW.decision: Observed current DECIW prices differ by station/power and the official 0.65 page is not sufficient current exhaustive proof. No global Citywatt fallback; resolve exact price per EVSE/site.
DECIW.unblockForComplete: Enumerate all 262 DECIW EVSEs and obtain authoritative current QR/direct-payment tariffs or Mobilithek/AFIR station-level records with source provenance and fee components.
